target_product.review_text:
I'm fairly familiar with KSEIBI tools, and I own a few different hand tools from them. They tend to copy more expensive brands and they do a decent job from my experience. This step bit set comes with 5 common sizes in a plastic case. The case itself isn't great, it's kind of cheap feeling but it is a nice way to keep the bits organized. I took the top off the case and just have the bottom half in my toolbox.

The bits themselves are fine. I have had the best results with lighter wood like particle board/MDF and thin metal like vent ducting. The company claims these can drill through cast iron but I haven't tried anything that hard. I'm not sure they would last long if you use these too often for thick metals. I really like step bits but they aren't something you use for exact hole drilling. I do like using them for quick projects and these are some of the nicer low cost step bits I've used. These sorts of bits don't really work for thicker materials as they aren't able to provide a consistent diameter for more than a couple millimeters, although the number 2 bit allows you to work with slightly thicker materials since it only has 6 steps.

I do appreciate the markings on the side, and they seem fairly accurate. The black finish makes them easy to read. I'm happy with these overall and don't have any complaints about the actual quality of the bits, I did think the storage case was a bit cheaply made and it's hard to snap closed compared to most other plastic storage cases.
